product_name: PNB Personal Loan Scheme for Public / for Self-Employed
selection_rationale: Official PNB unsecured personal loan scheme pages covering salaried (salary-through-PNB and check-off) and self-employed/professional borrowers.
notes: Salaried: up to 24x gross monthly salary, max ₹20 lakh, tenure up to 72 EMIs (60 for Defence personnel). Self-employed/professional variant: up to 10x average gross monthly income, max ₹5 lakh, max 60 EMIs or age 65. Personal loan interest is not quoted as an absolute number; it is priced off PNB's 1-year MCLR (9.10% w.e.f. 01.10.2026) plus a spread (retail advances table shows MCLR(1Yr)+1.25% and MCLR(1Yr)+2.00%). Processing fee 1.00% of loan amount (NIL for Defence personnel).

selection_rationale: Official Canara Bank unsecured personal loan (Canara Budget) page for confirmed salaried employees, with Prime and Delight customer segments.
